name: EXM_MILEAGE_POL_LINES
description: This table contains mileage rates for mileage expense policies.

columns.name: POLICY_LINE_ID
columns.description: Mileage policy rate line identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: MILEAGE_POLICY_ID
columns.description: Policy identifier for which rates are defined.

columns.name: TYPE_OF_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Type of rate line, such as base mileage rate, passenger rate, or add-on rate.

columns.name: RATE
columns.description: Reimbursable amount for mileage, passenger, or additional rate that is determined by specific criteria.

columns.name: CALCULATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Calculation method for deriving passenger rate or additional rate. Valid values are from the lookup EXM_CALCULATION_METHOD.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the rate is applicable.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the rate is no longer applicable.

columns.name: ROLE_ID
columns.description: Role for which this rate is applicable.

columns.name: ROLE_NAME
columns.description: Role name for which this rate is applicable, such as Director or Engineer.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Geography for which this rate is applicable.

columns.name: ZONE_CODE
columns.description: Zone code for which this rate is applicable, such as Geographical Location or Zone.

columns.name: GEOLOC_NAME
columns.description: Geographical location for which this rate is applicable.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency in which rate is defined.

columns.name: VEHICLE_CATEGORY
columns.description: Category of vehicle for which this rate is applicable. Valid values are from the lookup defined in the expense policy definition.

columns.name: VEHICLE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of vehicle for which this rate is applicable. Valid values are from the lookup defined in the expense policy definition.

columns.name: FUEL_TYPE
columns.description: Type of fuel for which this rate is applicable. Valid values are from the lookup defined in the expense policy definition.

columns.name: DISTANCE_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Highest threshold value in the distance range for which this rate is applicable. For example, for a distance range of 0 - 4000 miles, the value 4000 is stored.

columns.name: PASSENGER_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Indicates number of passengers when rates by number range of passengers is selected.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Additional rate code for which this rate is applicable. Valid values are from the lookup defined in the expense policy definition.

columns.name: RAW_COUNTRY
columns.description: Country of the location for which the rate is applicable.

columns.name: RAW_STATE
columns.description: State of the location for which the rate is applicable.

columns.name: RAW_COUNTY
columns.description: County of the location for which the rate is applicable.

columns.name: RAW_CITY
columns.description: City of the location for which the rate is applicable.

columns.name: RAW_LEVEL_5
columns.description: Component of the location for which the rate is applicable.

columns.name: GENDER_CODE
columns.description: Gender code for mileage expense policy.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the rate line, such as Valid, Active, and Invalid. Values are from the lookup EXM_POLICY_STATUS.

columns.name: INVALID_CODE
columns.description: Code indicating the reason that the rate line failed validatrion. Values are from the lookup EXM_POLICY_INVALID_CODE.
